get.description:
Return a list of all Budget View Summary Rows for a project and budget view. The type of row returned is dependent on
the value used in the group_by query param.

Note: In addition to all the fields outlined in the response, there will be an additional key for each visible
source and formula column created for the particular budget view.

parameters.name: biller[]
parameters.description: Return item(s) within a specific biller. Format is biller[]=id=1,type=SubJob or biller[]=id=1,type=Project

parameters.name: cost_code_id[]
parameters.description: Return item(s) within a specific Cost Code id or range of Cost Code IDs

parameters.name: cost_code_name[]
parameters.description: Return item(s) within a specific Cost Code name or range of Cost Code names

parameters.name: root_cost_code_id[]
parameters.description: Return item(s) within a specific Root Cost Code id or range of Root Cost Code IDs

parameters.name: root_cost_code_name[]
parameters.description: Return item(s) within a specific Root Cost Code name or range of Root Cost Code names

parameters.name: category_id[]
parameters.description: Return item(s) within a specific category id (line item type id) or range of category IDs

parameters.name: budget_line_item_id[]
parameters.description: Return item(s) within a specific budget line item id or range of budget line item IDs

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Groups the data. Value can be a comma separated string. Default is biller,root_cost_code

parameters.name: budget_row_type
parameters.description: Return budgeted, unbudgeted or all item(s) from all budget rows for a project. Default is budgeted. Note that when the unbudgeted or all values are supplied, the subtotals may change depending on the presence of rows that have budgeted false

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

schema.description: Array of Budget View Summary Rows

id.description: Identifier of the entity this summary row aggregates (e.g. a cost code, category, or biller, depending on the group_by used).

name.description: Display name of the entity this summary row aggregates.

biller_type.description: Whether the biller is the project itself or a sub job. Populated only when grouping by biller.

original_budget_amount.description: Original budgeted amount for this group, before any budget changes, as a decimal string.

budget_modifications.description: Net amount transferred to or from this group via budget modifications, as a decimal string.

budget_forecast.description: Forecasted budget totals for this group. Present only when the budget view includes a forecast column.

amount.description: Forecasted budget amount for this group, as a decimal string.

currency_configuration.description: Currency in which this row's monetary amounts are denominated.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the row's amounts.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/budget_views/%7Bbudget_view_id%7D/summary_rows?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&biller%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&cost_code_id%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&cost_code_name%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&root_cost_code_id%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&root_cost_code_name%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&category_id%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&budget_line_item_id%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&group_by=SOME_STRING_VALUE&budget_row_type=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
